description: Coordination registry for agent-custom-setup. ACS owns execution coordination for multi-agent work on one repository, shipped as the multi-agent hotload pack (join-order roles, boss lease, claim queue, agent-less watchdog, proposals). Path layout: modules/<area>/<setup-id>/v<semver>/. ACS is source of truth; Desktop paths are deploy mirrors.

modules.name: Multi-agent hotload coordination
modules.purpose: Install surface: hot-load the FULL stack (PCM + CGM 0.5.12 + OIO) + coordination runtime (join-order roles, 30m-default boss lease, GitHub claim queue, agent-less ~10m watchdog, proposals/claim/PR). Versions come from the release train via stack-mesh.json.

deploy_mirrors.label: ACS module tree (SoT; agents load from checkout)
deploy_mirrors.notes: ACS is SoT. Agents load from the checkout; no Desktop mirror required for this docs/runtime pack.

modules.summary: FULL PCM + FULL CGM 0.5.12 + OIO + coordination runtime (join-order, 30m lease, claim_queue, agent-less watchdog). The adopter follows the release train via stack-manifest.json (empty pins). Slim subsets are incomplete installs; an uninstallable component (e.g. OIO) is reported PARTIAL, never as success.
dependencies: PCM version and commit from stack-mesh.json (full stack)
CGM version and commit from stack-mesh.json (full eight modules incl. human-output-naming)

agent-stack-train stack-releases.json (certified version set the adopter manifest follows)
